liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (4 reviews): Phil drives the band into a nicely stretched-out Other One; Phil firmly steers the Other One from his first notes, making it the standout of the show [3][4][6][8]
- **Cumberland Blues** (2 reviews): Ramble On Rose and Cumberland Blues are singled out as especially good; Cumberland Blues is played tightly [3][6]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Tennessee Jed is singled out as a great version [9]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer wishes Keith had played piano on Playing In The Band [11]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 other source): Uploader's notes list One More Saturday Night next to Ramble On Rose, unlike the setlist [1]
- **That's It For The Other One** (1 review): One of the longest That's It For The Other One performances of 1971 [9]
- **Deal** (1 review): Deal follows directly, with a groovy, swinging feel [4]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): The jam coming out of the second Cryptical is sweet, with Keith prominent and tasteful [4]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-10-22.sbd.gans.miller.112821.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 3.91/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording is described as one of Charlie Miller's best; Jerry's guitar lacks prominence in the mix, though audible [8][13]
- **gd1971-10-22.set2.sbd.miller.86728.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 68 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer was 16 at the time of the concert and calls this a partial show [5]
- The circulating recording is short [6]
- At the opening of the first song, two men rushed the stage and were beaten by off-duty Chicago cop security [7]
- The incident dampened the mood, and Phil responded by pouring positive energy into the room, lifting band and audience [7]
- The first set is missing from circulation [7]
- Pigpen is absent from this show [11]
- The band executes the new October 1971 material skillfully [12]
- Jerry is having a truly on night [13]
- Reviewer rates this show on par with the 19 October show, which has more reviews and downloads [9]
- Reviewer thinks the Detroit show two days later is better, with more jams, though its tape has cuts [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-10-22.sbd.gans.miller.112821.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [1]. Also: Charlie Miller is credited with keeping The Other One intact in one piece; Tape came via a DAT from David Gans [1][11]
- **gd1971-10-22.set2.sbd.miller.86728.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) D [2]
